word: Title: Evening At The Small Museum
answer: Noche En El Museo Pequeño

word: I am going to tour the new exhibit first.
answer: Voy a recorrer la nueva exhibición primero.

word: You identify the oldest piece in the room. [sing, formal]
answer: Identifica la pieza más antigua del cuarto.

word: We reflect on the history behind each object.
answer: Reflejamos la historia detrás de cada objeto.

word: They publish a brochure with details.
answer: Publican un folleto con detalles.

word: I remove my jacket because it’s warm.
answer: Quito mi chamarra porque hace calor.

word: You are going to represent the group in the talk. [pl]
answer: Van a representar al grupo en la charla.

word: We occupy a quiet corner to read.
answer: Ocupamos una esquina tranquila para leer.

word: They pretend to be explorers from the past.
answer: Pretenden ser exploradores del pasado.

word: You forget your map near the entrance. [sing, inf]
answer: Olvidas tu mapa cerca de la entrada.

word: We are going to solve the clues in the exhibit.
answer: Vamos a resolver las pistas en la exhibición.

word: They concern themselves with finding every detail.
answer: Se preocupan por encontrar cada detalle.

word: I participate in a short guided tour.
answer: Participo en una visita guiada corta.

word: You pay the small entry fee. [sing, formal]
answer: Paga la cuota de entrada.

word: We link the artifacts to different eras.
answer: Relacionamos las piezas con distintas épocas.

word: They retrieve their coats from the rack.
answer: Recuperan sus abrigos del perchero.

word: I start reading the description of a sculpture.
answer: Parto a leer la descripción de una escultura.

word: You are going to organize the photos later. [pl]
answer: Van a organizar las fotos más tarde.

word: We describe the colors of an old mural.
answer: Describimos los colores de un mural antiguo.

word: They cut the visit short because it’s late.
answer: Cortan la visita porque ya es tarde.

word: You force the door a bit; it sticks. [sing, inf]
answer: Obligas un poco la puerta; se atora.

word: I make a note about my favorite piece.
answer: Realizo una nota sobre mi pieza favorita.

word: We determine which exhibit to see next.
answer: Determinamos qué exhibición ver después.

word: They indicate the exit with a small sign.
answer: Indican la salida con un letrero pequeño.

word: You are going to return for the weekend event. [sing, formal]
answer: Va a regresar para el evento del fin de semana.

word: We are going to publish our photos tonight.
answer: Vamos a publicar nuestras fotos esta noche.
